label: IS-IS
notes: IS-IS common header (ISO/IEC 10589 §7.3.9, republished as RFC 1142) over 802.2 LLC on Ethernet: DSAP/SSAP 0xFE with UI control 0x03, sent to 01:80:c2:00:00:14 (allL1ISs) or 01:80:c2:00:00:15 (allL2ISs). The anchor base is 17 (14-byte Ethernet + 3-byte LLC) and the locator matches the LLC DSAP/SSAP bytes. All eight fixed bytes are modelled; the PDU type byte splits into a 5-bit type view and the three reserved high bits. Everything after byte 8 is PDU-type-dependent TLV territory (hello parameters, LSP entries, SNP records) with no fixed offsets, and no checksum lives in the common header — authentication and checksum TLVs ride in the variable body. ES-IS (NLPID 0x82) and CLNP (0x81) share the LLC framing but are separate protocols.

fields.label: NLPID
fields.description: Intradomain Routing Protocol Discriminator; 0x83 identifies IS-IS (0x81 CLNP and 0x82 ES-IS share the LLC framing).

fields.label: Header Length
fields.description: Length of the fixed part of the PDU header in bytes; 27 for LAN hellos, PDU-type dependent.

fields.label: PDU Type
fields.description: Low 5 bits of byte 4 identify the PDU type.

fields.label: Reserved Bits
fields.description: Three reserved bits above the PDU type; zero.

fields.label: Max Area Addresses
fields.description: Number of manual area addresses configured for this router; 0 means 3.
